packageRules.description: Anything below a major bump merges itself once CI is green.
Workflow actions move together and merge themselves.
Majors land by hand. React, Vite and Fastify all ship breaking changes, and the smoke test is not broad enough to catch them.
The runtime version is set in three places and they have to agree.
The React plugin carries a peer range on Vite, so bumping either one alone fails to resolve. They move as a pair.
React and its DOM renderer are versioned in lockstep.
